**KJFH11** is a Danish SMR procedure code used to classify laparoscopic colectomy and ileostomy [^src1]. Within the Danish Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) quality database, this code is tracked under Quality Indicator 6, which monitors surgical interventions and reoperations among IBD patients to evaluate and maintain clinical standards [^src1]. 

According to the 2024 DANIBD report, KJFH11 holds significant clinical prevalence: it was the second most frequently recorded surgical procedure for IBD patients during the reporting period [^src1]. The code was logged 106 times, accounting for 10.1% of the procedures in its specific statistical category [^src1]. These figures contribute to the broader epidemiological and clinical dataset used for quality monitoring and the ongoing development of treatment standards in Danish IBD care [^src1].
